ruleset.name: DigiBank Java quality gate
ruleset.description: Focused production-code baseline: unused code, unsafe patterns and avoidable complexity. Style and documentation rules are intentionally omitted to keep findings actionable. UnusedPrivateField and UnusedPrivateMethod are omitted because Lombok-generated accessors and JPA/Spring reflection can consume members without visible Java source references. Test sources are excluded: fixture repetition and assertion patterns need a separate policy. Add any future false-positive suppression narrowly, with an explanation next to it.
